title: How PayPal CEO Enrique Lores, appointed earlier in 2026 to revive the payments pioneer, may handle Stripe and Advent's takeover offer, based on his HP tenure (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: How PayPal CEO Enrique Lores, appointed earlier in 2026 to revive the payments pioneer, may handle Stripe and Advent's takeover offer, based on his HP tenure — Enrique Lores took the top job at the payments company earlier this year after decades at HP — Digital-payments pioneer PayPal is in a yearslong rut.
